main.description: Merge a pull request by commit. The knot merges the pull's latest version onto its target branch, merging the stack below first, and writes the merged status record in the same critical section as the branch update.

repo.description: DID of the repository the pull lives on

rkey.description: Record key of the pull to merge

tip.description: Commit id the target branch ended on; the standing tip when the merge needed no move

merged.description: At-uris of the pulls this call marked merged, bottom of the stack first

errors.name: MergeConflict
errors.description: A version's changes don't apply cleanly onto the target branch

errors.name: ClosedPull
errors.description: The pull, or a pull its stack depends on, is closed

errors.name: BranchMoved
errors.description: The target branch kept moving while the merge ran; the merged status stands, and the boot pass finishes the move once the branch is back at the old tip

errors.name: NoSuchBranch
errors.description: The pull's target branch no longer exists on the repository
